## Cover sheet
| National population projections: 2024-based |
| --- |
| Date published: 28 April 2026 |
| Coverage: Great Britain (GB) |
| Projection: Principal projection |
| This spreadsheet contains 12 sheets, 10 of which contain data tables |
| Publication Details |
| The data tables in this spreadsheet were published at 9:30am on 28 April 2026. |
| Tables are available in this release for: United Kingdom, Great Britain, England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland. |
| These machine-readable data tables provide our most detailed projections data and are also for users with systems designed to use these. |
| The release also includes summary datasets – these contain population projections data by broad age group, components of change and other summary statistics. To access this dataset type please see the |
| National population projections table of contents. |
| For information about all national population projections releases please see the |
| National population projections statistical bulletins. |
| Background Information |
| National population projections (NPPs) provide an indication of the potential future population size of the UK and its constituent countries. These statistics are widely used in planning; for example, fiscal projections, health, education, and pensions. |
| For more information on the national population projections data and method, please see the accompanying article 'National population projections quality and methods guide'. |
| Data Sources |
| For guidance on data used and statistics for mid-2024 and mid-2025, we refer users to the accompanying article 'National population projections quality and methods guide'. |
| These projections are Accredited Official Statistics. |
| Methodology notes |
| Due to rounding in our assumption setting and the methodology used, data in these tables may not sum to totals because of rounding in the underlying data. |
| Information on the data, methods and assumption setting process used to produce the 2024-based NPPs can be found in articles providing information on fertility, mortality and migration assumptions from the |
| National population projections table of contents. |
| Quality and methodology guide for NPPs, detailing the strengths and limitations of the data, methods used and data uses can be found in |
| National population projections quality and methods guide. |
